description: 8–12 real-style discussion fixtures for Skill-first shadow vs control

samples.title: Browser-use session restore
samples.text: Browser-use loses session state after a mid-task tab crash. I have to re-login and restart the agent from scratch. Workaround: manually snapshot cookies, but that fails for SPA auth.

samples.title: Agent tool calling timeout
samples.text: Our agent hangs when a tool call times out. It never cancels the pending step and keeps retrying the same tool. Users see a spinning UI for minutes.

samples.title: Human-in-the-loop approval lost
samples.text: When the human approval modal closes accidentally, the agent continues without confirmation. We expected it to pause. Happens in Chrome only.

samples.title: RAG retrieval noise
samples.text: Knowledge retrieval returns unrelated notes when the query mentions 'agent'. Indexing seems fine; ranking dumps marketing blog posts over the internal runbook.

samples.title: Eval flake on CI
samples.text: Agent eval suite flakes on CI when network is slow. Local runs pass. We mark tests skipped which hides real regressions.

samples.title: OpenCLI bridge down recovery
samples.text: When opencli bridge is down, Finch reports empty results as if no posts existed. We need failures to surface as failed, not empty success.

samples.title: GitHub issue closed but unfixed
samples.text: Maintainers closed the issue as 'not planned' but users still reproduce the crash on v1.4. Closing is treated by some bots as fixed — that is wrong.

samples.title: Multi-agent handoff drops context
samples.text: In a multi-agent harness, handoff to the worker agent drops the last three tool results. Parent agent assumes the worker saw them.

samples.title: Ask HN: stuck agents
samples.text: Ask HN: how do you detect when an agent is stuck in a tool loop? We only notice after burn rate alerts. Looking for first-hand ops practices, not product pitches.

samples.title: Reddit: memory bloat
samples.text: r/LocalLLaMA: long agent sessions balloon RAM because transcript is kept verbatim. Truncation helpers delete the wrong turns and break resume.
